title: Prerequisite Tree Input
description: Input schema for prt_builder.py. Defines an ambitious target and the obstacles that must be overcome to reach it, each with an intermediate objective and dependency list.

target.description: The ambitious target — a single clear statement of what you want to achieve. State as a positive condition that will exist when the goal is reached.
examples: Enterprise tier is live and generating revenue from at least 3 paying enterprise customers
Self-serve onboarding converts users to paid plans without human intervention

obstacles.description: Every obstacle standing between the current state and the target. Each obstacle must have an intermediate objective (IO) that neutralizes it.

id.description: Unique identifier for this obstacle. Used in dependency references. Convention: O1, O2, O3 or descriptive slugs like 'no-sso'.

description.description: The obstacle as a current negative condition. State what is missing or wrong today, not what you plan to do about it. Start with 'We have no...', 'There is no...', or 'X does not...'
examples: Enterprise pricing has not been validated with real prospects
The sales team has no enterprise pitch materials

intermediate_objective.description: The minimum positive condition that neutralizes this obstacle. Must be verifiable by any observer — a clear definition of done. State as 'X exists', 'X is true', or 'X can do Y'.
examples: SSO authenticates users via SAML 2.0 against at least one enterprise identity provider
3 target enterprise prospects confirm willingness to pay at the proposed price point
Admins can invite, remove, and assign roles to team members via a self-serve UI

dependencies.description: IDs of other obstacles whose intermediate objectives must be achieved before this obstacle can be addressed. Leave empty for obstacles that can be tackled immediately.

items.description: An obstacle ID from the same obstacles list

examples.target: Enterprise tier is live and generating revenue from at least 3 paying enterprise customers

obstacles.intermediate_objective: SSO authenticates users via SAML 2.0 against at least one enterprise identity provider

obstacles.description: Enterprise pricing has not been validated with real prospects
obstacles.intermediate_objective: 3 target enterprise prospects confirm willingness to pay at the proposed price point

obstacles.description: We have no admin UI for managing team members
obstacles.intermediate_objective: Admins can invite, remove, and assign roles to team members via a self-serve UI

obstacles.description: The sales team has no enterprise pitch materials
obstacles.intermediate_objective: Sales deck, ROI calculator, and security FAQ are approved and available to all AEs

obstacles.description: We have no dedicated enterprise onboarding process
obstacles.intermediate_objective: Enterprise onboarding playbook has been piloted end-to-end with one real customer
